Your confirmation of the final summary establishes the authoritative requirements record.

zh-CN.text:
确认关键细节与预期，避免采用可行但不符合预期的方案。
最终需求摘要经用户确认后，形成权威需求记录。
zh-CN.source:
Confirm key details and expectations to avoid solutions that work but miss your intent.
Your confirmation of the final summary establishes the authoritative requirements record.

ja.text:
重要な詳細と期待を確認し、実現可能でも意図に合わない案を避けます。
最終的な要件のまとめをユーザーが確認すると、正式な要件記録になります。

Confirm key details and expectations to avoid solutions that work but miss your intent.
Your confirmation of the final summary establishes the authoritative requirements record.

ko.source:
Confirm key details and expectations to avoid solutions that work but miss your intent.
Your confirmation of the final summary establishes the authoritative requirements record.

de.text:
Wichtige Details und Erwartungen klären, damit eine machbare Lösung auch zur Absicht passt.
Erst die Bestätigung der abschließenden Zusammenfassung macht den Anforderungsstand verbindlich.

Confirm key details and expectations to avoid solutions that work but miss your intent.

ja.text: 要件を正式な基準とし、仕様・設計・計画・タスクの追跡可能性を保ちます。レビューで問題が見つかったら、修正してから次へ進みます。

ko.source: Requirements establish the authoritative baseline. Specifications, designs, plans and tasks remain traceable; review findings are fixed before proceeding.

de.text: Anforderungen bilden die verbindliche Grundlage. Spezifikation, Entwurf, Plan und Aufgaben bleiben rückverfolgbar. Review-Befunde werden vor dem nächsten Schritt behoben.

fr.text: Les exigences font autorité. Spécifications, conceptions, plans et tâches restent traçables. Les problèmes relevés en revue sont corrigés avant de poursuivre.
fr.source: Requirements establish the authoritative baseline. Specifications, designs, plans and tasks remain traceable; review findings are fixed before proceeding.

es.text: Los requisitos fijan la referencia autorizada. Especificaciones, diseños, planes y tareas mantienen la trazabilidad. Los problemas detectados se corrigen antes de avanzar.
